title: I'm building a cozy gachapon shop sim in Unity with Claude Code. Free demo out now
author: gasvel
selftext:
Hi r/aigamedev! This is Capsule Corner, a cozy first-person sim where you run a tiny gachapon  shop. You restock the machines, set prices, collect the coins, give change at the counter, open mystery boxes, put them on sale, run a claw machine and design your own shop.

After a few months in developmetn the demo is out now for free on [itch.io](http://itch.io) (Windows): [https://oddloop42.itch.io/capsule-corner](https://oddloop42.itch.io/capsule-corner)



*How AI fits in my workflow*

Code: most of the C# was written with Claude Code in Unity, including the systems and the customer AI. I make the design calls, test everything and steer it. It's very much "AI does the typing, I do the game design."

Editor tooling: instead of building the shop by hand, Claude wrote editor scripts that generate the modular shop kit, the machines, the decor and the collection covers. Fixing a prop means re-running a builder, not dragging things around.

Tests: EditMode/PlayMode tests for the economy, saving, the claw machine, mystery boxes and more. They catch regressions when the AI refactors something.

Not AI: Most assets are CC0 or CC-by.

**What I'd love feedback on**

Does the core loop (restock → sell → collect → grow) read from the video?

If you've shipped something AI-assisted: **how did you talk about it on your store page? Did players care?**

Thanks for watching!
